products.name: Noir Absolu
products.shortDescription: An intoxicating, velvety oud interwoven with smoky incense and rare golden amber.
products.description: Noir Absolu is an opulent woody-oriental fragrance that opens with spicy bursts of Calabrian bergamot and cracked black pepper, gradually revealing a hypnotic heart of Cambodian oud and crimson damascena rose. The drydown settles into a warm, persistent embrace of amber resin, velvet musk, and aged Mysore sandalwood.

reviews.title: Mesmerizing smoky oud with breathtaking longevity
reviews.body: Noir Absolu is truly in a league of its own. The transition from the sharp bergamot into dark Cambodian oud is seamless. Lasted over 12 hours on my coat, and I received endless compliments during a dinner reception. Exceptional presentation.

reviews.title: Rich, dark, and sensual
reviews.body: I bought the 50ml bottle after testing the 2ml complimentary vial. The amber-sandalwood drydown is pure velvet. Luxurious without being cloying.

reviews.title: Bold signature fragrance for winter evenings
reviews.body: Very potent projection. Two sprays are more than enough. If you love deep woody scents with an oriental spine, you cannot go wrong.

reviews.title: The most delicate, authentic morning rose
reviews.body: Unlike synthetic rose perfumes, Rose Éclat smells like walking through dew-drenched rose gardens in Tuscany. The vanilla note in the base adds a creamy finish that stays close to skin all day.

reviews.title: Ideal bridal and spring signature
reviews.body: Wore this for an outdoor wedding and it was divine. Clean, romantic, and beautifully blended with jasmine.

reviews.title: Incredible summer revitalizer
reviews.body: The grapefruit and basil combination is electric. On hot summer days, this cuts through the heat and keeps you feeling freshly showered and energized.

reviews.title: Authentic royal oud perfection
reviews.body: Being from the Middle East, I have smelled hundreds of oud fragrances. Oud Mystique hits the mark with genuine Cambodian agarwood and saffron. It performs like a high-end niche extrait.

reviews.title: Smells like genuine ocean surf
reviews.body: The sea salt and ambrette seed interplay is masterfully done. It doesn't smell like a generic shower gel; it smells like a brisk morning walk on a secluded beach.

reviews.title: The definition of quiet luxury
reviews.body: Subtle, creamy, and sophisticated. The orris root and sandalwood create a calm cocoon around you. Never shouts, yet everyone leans in to ask what you are wearing.

reviews.title: Gourmand heaven without cloying sweetness
reviews.body: Vanille Céleste is warm, intoxicating, and cozy. The bitter almond cuts through the rich Madagascar vanilla bean. My all-time favorite cold weather scent.

reviews.title: Distinguished, masculine, and commanding
reviews.body: Reminiscent of old British clubs with mahogany paneling and pipe tobacco. The pink pepper opening transitions into an earthy vetiver and tobacco base. Superb craftsmanship.
